summary: Preserve full-detail condition evidence, distinct certification and HGJ verification, and bounded saved observations for explicit food and prayer planning.
reason: The public source streams HTML cards with hidden conditions and exposes separate restaurant and prayer-place evidence. Regeneration must retain canonical identity, unknown and inapplicable states, truthful cache semantics and local planning rather than converting raw cards or Muslim-friendly labels into compliance guarantees. Saved reads must fail explicitly during pending or changing WAL state rather than present checkpointed older observations as current. Final polish removes six proven-unused generated CLI helpers while preserving the helper-called dry-run detector. Dry-run validates the same required IDs, scoped filters, selections and bounds before returning a no-I/O receipt. Zero-result search pages with same-kind parsed cards fail closed to prevent unrelated recommendations being reported as hits. The actual deferred result-summary paragraph explicitly says No results found. for empty searches and must map to source_total0; a generic unmatched paragraph must remain a format error. Canonical path and selected-file identity checks cover reads and snapshot writes; ambiguous hard-linked caches are rejected before writer opening and around save, preventing a successful source observation from being overwritten by a separate alias WAL. Immutable SQL readers use a private128MiB-bounded snapshot copied from a verified pinned descriptor, with copy/post-read source checks and cleanup, so a pathname swap-and-restore cannot select a different inode. Reserved file-URI bytes percent/question-mark/hash are rejected on selected and canonical cache paths before SQLite preflight. Validate the canonical private temporary destination too: a reserved TMPDIR byte must never redirect the immutable SQLite URI to unrelated rows. Pin modernc.org/sqlite v1.46.2 with exact libc v1.70.0: bundled SQLite3.51.3 fixes the official WAL-reset corruption race for cooperating writers.
validated_outcome: Real Tokyo searches and full details, five local plans and all nine MCP tools pass; the known food/prayer coordinate pair is 2.255 km and missing change baselines remain explicit.
